statement:
The customer cancelled his Fitline membership on 3 July and the club confirmed the cancellation. Since the membership is no longer active, I will refuse the charge.

judge_text:
WRONG
The answer contradicts the record's "active, renewing" status by asserting "the membership is no longer active" based on the confirmed cancellation, and refuses the charge.
